recommendation: Keep this audit. If SupplyRequest.item changes are needed in the future, make them in HL7/oo-incubator unless SupplyRequest is migrated back into core.
issue_request: FHIR-26301 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and requested SupplyRequest.item be updated after the Device/DeviceDefinition split to allow DeviceDefinition, using the R5 CodeableReference direction.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-26301 source commit was found. The R5 source conversion commit 33b409a4b6 introduced SupplyRequest.item as CodeableReference with DeviceDefinition among the targets, and v5.0.0/R5 contains that target.
additional_context: FHIR-26826 is the same clone request. FHIR-26827 later closed the R4 extension/pre-adoption request as Not Persuasive because R5 already had the ability. Later product/supply work added more targets but retained DeviceDefinition. Commit 3b38b80cf2 removed SupplyRequest from active core resource registration and pointed core links to the OO Incubator; OO minutes confirmed SupplyRequest was selected for the Additional Resources path.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No core source edit is appropriate because SupplyRequest is outside the current core build scope and the active OO Incubator StructureDefinition already includes DeviceDefinition on SupplyRequest.item.

related_jiras.note: Clone of the same SupplyRequest.item DeviceDefinition request and the seed for this reconciliation.
R4 pre-adoption extension request was closed Not Persuasive because R5 already had the ability.
Broader product/inventory work later added InventoryItem to SupplyRequest.item without removing DeviceDefinition.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue requesting DeviceDefinition as a SupplyRequest.item choice for R5.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final WG intent for the original issue.

evidence_items.summary: OO minutes record an 8-0-0 motion to include DeviceDefinition in the SupplyRequest.item reference choice.
evidence_items.learned: This confirms the vote behind the Jira disposition.

evidence_items.summary: Retained core source defines SupplyRequest.item as CodeableReference and includes DeviceDefinition in targetProfile.
evidence_items.learned: The checked source content contains the requested choice even though the resource is no longer active in core fhir.ini.

evidence_items.summary: R5 source conversion introduced SupplyRequest.item with DeviceDefinition among its target profiles and is contained in v5.0.0.
evidence_items.learned: The requested change was present in the R5 publication line despite no explicit FHIR-26301 implementation commit.

evidence_items.summary: Removed SupplyRequest from active core fhir.ini registration and repointed core links to the OO Incubator.
evidence_items.learned: SupplyRequest belongs outside the current core build scope.

evidence_items.summary: The current OO Incubator package has SupplyRequest.item targetProfile DeviceDefinition.
evidence_items.learned: The active external artifact still satisfies the requested capability.

evidence_items.locator: Community search for FHIR-26301/FHIR-26826 and SupplyRequest DeviceDefinition
